title: Olive and Fig in the Barn
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds x, y, z

pages.illustration: Olive the grey owl and Fig the green caterpillar standing together at the open doorway of an old wooden barn.

pages.text: It is big. It is dim.
pages.illustration: A wide dim view inside the barn, tall stacks of hay, little light coming through the gaps.

pages.text: Olive hops on a box. Fig is not in it.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl hopping onto an old wooden box in the dim barn, peering inside it.
Olive the owl perched on the hay bale with her beak open, calling out into the dim barn.

pages.text: Fig is not on top. Fig is not in a pot.
pages.illustration: An empty hay bale top and an empty plain clay pot on the barn floor, Olive peering down from above at both.

pages.text: Fig pops up! Fig sat in a sack.
pages.illustration: Fig the green caterpillar poking his head out of the top of a cloth sack on the barn floor, grinning.

pages.text: Olive is not sad. Olive has fun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl hopping down beside the sack, smiling at Fig.

pages.text: Olive and Fig sit. Olive and Fig hum.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar sitting side by side on the hay bale together.
